content:
Ari Fernandez: Cobalt Health (COB-502) tried to pay INV-5055 ($5,400) with their corporate card and it was declined. Customer sees a 3DS challenge that their admin can't complete right now. Error in Stripe: 'authentication_required' with next_action 'use_stripe_sdk'. They need access restored today.
Samir Patel: auth_required means issuer wants a 3DS flow. If they can't complete 3DS we can either accept a different card, do a same-day wire, or approve emergency credit for up to 7 days (finance signoff). Any decline code from Stripe?
PaymentsBot: ALERT: Payment attempt failed for INV-5055. Error: authentication_required. Stripe event id evt_3KZ9Abx. Suggested actions: generate manual pay link, retry 3DS, or request bank transfer. Ticket PAY-8010 created.
Ari Fernandez: Customer says their IT admin is unavailable until evening. They can provide company ACH info but can't upload voided check immediately. They asked if we can provision a 48-hr trial unlock while payment is sorted.
Kira Mah: We occasionally provision emergency access for renewals but require a signed promissory email and finance approval. For $5,400 I'd want Nora to ok a short-term unlock. Also log as credit exposure.
Nora Li: I'm on board to approve a 48-hour emergency access if customer emails a signed promise to pay and we capture a PCI one-time card token or bank trace within 48 hours. No fee, but must get written acknowledgment. Will not approve beyond 72 hours.
Samir Patel: Ok — options for Ari to offer: (1) send manual one-time-pay link (expires 2 hours), (2) offer same-day wire (needs routing/account + waiver), or (3) temporary unlock for 48 hrs with signed promissory email. Draft text for promissory: "Cobalt Health authorizes Redwood Inference to provision temporary access for INV-5055. We agree to remit $5,400 via wire or card within 48 hours."
Ari Fernandez: Sent manual pay link and promissory template. Customer replied with signed email (attached) and asked for temporary unlock now. They also provided ACH details: Bank: Meridian Trust (routing 444000666), Account type: checking, acct: ****6789 (last 4). They said bank will not accept microdeposits until Monday.
PaymentsBot: NOTE: PROMISSORY RECEIVED. Ticket PAY-8010 updated. Subtask PAY-8010-TEMP-UNLOCK created. Audit: record temporary access approved by Nora Li.
Nora Li: Confirming approval. Finance will permit temporary unlock for 48 hours given promissory + capture of ACH last 4 and follow-up trace. If payment not received within 48 hours we'll suspend and bill late fee per T&C. Please attach promissory to PAY-8010.
Samir Patel: Granting access now and noting exposure. Ari, once you get bank trace or card token, upload to PAY-8010 and mark invoice as pending settlement. I'll monitor.
Ari Fernandez: Access enabled. Customer says they'll initiate wire if 3DS fails tonight. I'll update thread when funds confirm. Thanks everyone.
PaymentsBot: ACTION: Marking INV-5055 as provisionally cleared for 48 hours. Reminder set: 48-hr follow-up for PAY-8010.
Samir Patel: Closing loop — will change invoice status on verification. Marking thread resolved pending payment or suspension. :white_check_mark:
